n6ae6d8524e.summary: Rising diesel prices make Chinese electric trucks more cost-effective in Asia, accelerating exports. Costs and infrastructure challenges remain.
n6ae6d8524e.why: Chinese electric truck makers are key suppliers of commercial vehicles, and their export growth depends on fuel prices and charging infrastructure.

ndb6c26dd5a.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne oil exports from the Gulf, so disruptions there move global crude prices.

n356c24c0ce.why: DeepSeek is a Chinese AI developer whose pricing and funding shape competition in the artificial intelligence model market, where Tencent and JD.com are major platform owners.

n3b1ddf0ca2.why: Housing policy and household debt levels influence Greece's construction activity, mortgage market and consumer spending.

n1a22902e6a.why: The KOSPI is South Korea's benchmark stock index, heavily weighted toward large chipmakers such as Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.

n34ec3a4943.headline: Mount Etna ash shuts Sicily’s largest airport during peak holiday week
n34ec3a4943.summary: Ash from Mount Etna shut Sicily's largest airport during the peak holiday week. Etna is the largest active volcano in Europe.
n34ec3a4943.why: Airport closures disrupt airline schedules and tourism, a significant revenue source for Sicily and southern Italy.

ned2c1630ba.headline: War-driven energy costs push inflation outlook higher - Latest News
ned2c1630ba.summary: Turkey's central bank now forecasts end-2026 inflation at 28%, citing war-driven energy costs and higher food prices. Governor Fatih Karahan said the revision did not reflect a worsening underlying inflation trend.
ned2c1630ba.why: The central bank sets Turkey's policy rate and its inflation forecasts guide monetary policy. Revisions shape expectations for interest rates, bonds and the lira.

nda7fae85af.headline: Temporary diesel tax relief targets price pressures - Latest News
nda7fae85af.summary: Türkiye has reduced the special consumption tax on diesel to zero for the remainder of August. The measure aims to limit fuel-related cost and inflation pressures.
nda7fae85af.why: Fuel taxes feed directly into transport costs and consumer inflation, so changes to them affect Turkish price trends and fiscal revenue.

n8114d99986.headline: WA stares down 'east coast clowns' over costly GST deal
n8114d99986.summary: WA Premier Roger Cook has promised to fight any move to strip his state of its lucrative GST share, in a dispute with other states over the costly GST deal.
n8114d99986.why: GST revenue shares distribute national tax receipts among states, which determines state budgets.

n6fd94b344b.headline: Mortgage rates fall to lowest level in nearly 4 weeks
n6fd94b344b.summary: The average rate on a 30-year fixed mortgage fell to 6.69%, its lowest level in nearly four weeks, according to Mortgage News Daily.
n6fd94b344b.why: Mortgage rates track long-term Treasury yields and influence housing affordability and activity.

n70e71e3ca3.headline: Forex kitty swells $14.1 b to 4-month high of $707 b on strong dollar inflows
n70e71e3ca3.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves swelled to a four-month high above $707 billion for the week to August 7, one of the largest weekly additions, on strong dollar inflows.
n70e71e3ca3.why: Foreign exchange reserves provide a buffer for the central bank to defend the rupee and manage external shocks.

naf8c5b9f7e.headline: Iran’s Labor Market Is Collapsing Beyond the Unemployment Rate
naf8c5b9f7e.summary: Iran's labour market is deteriorating as workers leave the formal economy and industrial jobs disappear. Informal employment and economic hardship are reported to be rising.
naf8c5b9f7e.why: Labour market weakness signals broader economic stress, which affects demand, social stability and investment risk in the country.

n2439e3bb25.headline: Tehran says Strait of Hormuz "under Iran's control" after Trump threat
n2439e3bb25.summary: Tehran said the Strait of Hormuz is under Iran's control and management, after President Trump said the US might keep it. The statement adds to tensions over the critical waterway.
n2439e3bb25.why: The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most important oil chokepoints, and disputes over access to it directly affect energy prices and shipping costs.
n2439e3bb25.why_moved: Competing claims over control of the Strait of Hormuz raise the risk of disruption to oil shipments.

n5c186201b3.headline: Port of Salalah cuts energy intensity as cargo volumes surge
n5c186201b3.summary: Port of Salalah cut the energy used per unit of container traffic by 12.7% in 2025, while cargo volumes grew sharply. The port is in Oman.
n5c186201b3.why: Salalah is a major container transhipment hub on the Arabian Sea, and its throughput and efficiency affect regional trade flows and logistics costs.

n029e6941a5.headline: Two slicks appear in Gulf as huge oil spill off Oman threatens disaster
n029e6941a5.summary: Two oil slicks appeared in Iranian waters near two Iranian islands, according to satellite imagery verified by Reuters. Iran and the US have exchanged attacks on tankers and vessels, complicating clean-up.
n029e6941a5.why: The Persian Gulf carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so spills and attacks in the region affect shipping, insurance and crude supply.

n06b7393baa.headline: Nat cat losses drag IAG’s profit down 25%
n06b7393baa.summary: Insurance Australia Group's net profit fell 25% year on year to A$1 billion for the fiscal year ended June 30. Higher natural peril claims partly drove the decline.
n06b7393baa.why: Insurance Australia Group is one of Australia's largest general insurers, so its claims experience reflects broader industry risk from natural disasters.

n25c02102c3.headline: ‘Time to move on’: Bombay High Court to Vijay Mallya, SBI as ₹15,000 crore recovery takes centre stage - BusinessToday
n25c02102c3.summary: Bombay High Court is addressing the ₹15,000 crore recovery case against Vijay Mallya and State Bank of India. Mallya's extradition to India has been approved by UK courts, but his return is delayed by further British proceedings.
n25c02102c3.why: State Bank of India is India's largest state-owned lender, so recovery outcomes on large defaulted loans affect its balance sheet and asset quality.

n07b1815b12.headline: Maersk raises 2026 forecast as freight rates and volumes lift Q2 earnings
n07b1815b12.summary: A.P. Moller-Maersk raised its 2026 profit forecast for the second time after higher container freight rates and stronger cargo volumes. Second-quarter revenue rose 20% to $15.76 billion and EBITDA rose 30% to $2.99 billion.
n07b1815b12.why: Maersk is one of the world's largest container shipping companies, so its forecasts are a read on global trade volumes and freight rates.

n01054b8dc6.headline: Oil prices today: Crude edges higher as US-Iran tensions revive supply concerns
n01054b8dc6.summary: Oil prices edged higher as the United States threatened to maintain a naval blockade of Iran indefinitely. Weaker demand forecasts and rising US inventories limited the gains.
n01054b8dc6.why: Crude oil prices are set by global supply and demand, and disruptions to Iranian exports directly affect available barrels.
n01054b8dc6.why_moved: Prices rose on renewed supply concerns from the threatened blockade, though weaker demand forecasts and rising US inventories capped gains.

n811c24d19f.headline: The next person chosen to help decide mortgage rates
n811c24d19f.summary: Melinda Cilento, head of the economic think tank CEDA, will become the newest member of the nine-person board responsible for setting interest rates. The appointment was reported this week.
n811c24d19f.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia board sets the country's cash rate, which drives mortgage pricing and broader financial conditions.

n0800e21988.headline: MSCI adds AI, semiconductor stocks to China Index, removes solar names
n0800e21988.summary: MSCI is adding 33 companies to its MSCI China Index, including a cluster of semiconductor-related firms and AI developer Zhipu AI. It is also deleting 32 stocks, according to Caixin.
n0800e21988.why: MSCI index inclusions and deletions drive passive fund flows, so changes to the China index can shift demand for constituent shares. Chinese chip and AI names are a focus for global investors.
n0800e21988.why_moved: The index adds semiconductor and AI-related firms while removing solar names, which reshuffles passive fund holdings across these sectors.

n2c86c8b967.headline: Nap time over for baby goods giant as profits jump
n2c86c8b967.summary: Australia's biggest baby goods retailer reported a profit jump after investing in new stores. The retailer has shifted its focus to a redesigned store format.
n2c86c8b967.why: Baby Bunting is a listed Australian specialty retailer, and its results reflect discretionary spending on family goods.

n763a0982b3.headline: Sebi proposes mandatory colour-coded Credit Risk-o-Meter for debt securities
n763a0982b3.summary: India's Sebi proposed a mandatory colour-coded Credit Risk-o-Meter for debt securities. Issuers and online platforms would have to display it in relevant documents, and public feedback is being sought.
n763a0982b3.why: The Securities and Exchange Board of India regulates the country's capital markets. A standard credit risk gauge aims to help investors compare the risk of debt instruments.

n2a1151f1d9.headline: Vance: Keeping Gas Prices Down Is War's Number One Goal
n2a1151f1d9.summary: Vice President JD Vance said the main US goal in the war with Iran is keeping oil and gas prices low. He said the conflict, which began in February, has raised gas prices because of Iran's blockade.
n2a1151f1d9.why: Energy prices feed into inflation and consumer spending, so US war policy that targets fuel costs is closely watched by investors.

nec5c12fea1.headline: Pakistan celebrates Independence Day: Here
nec5c12fea1.summary: Pakistan's KSE-100 index has returned 23% over the past year despite geopolitical tensions and volatility. It has slipped around 6% from its record high in January, while younger investors are entering the market.
nec5c12fea1.why: The KSE-100 is Pakistan's main benchmark index, tracking the largest companies listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.

ne681ec35a0.headline: Sunrise Market Commentary
ne681ec35a0.summary: US Treasuries outperformed German Bunds and UK Gilts after a July wholesale price report close to consensus. Investors also weighed weak payrolls and a tame CPI report.
ne681ec35a0.why: Treasury yields are the global benchmark for government borrowing costs and are shaped by inflation and jobs data.

ndabbb34505.headline: Sammaan Capital shares fall 4% after Q1 profit declines 27% YoY to Rs 243 crore, revenue drops 31%
ndabbb34505.summary: Sammaan Capital reported a 27% year-on-year fall in consolidated profit to Rs 243 crore in Q1FY27, with revenue also declining. The company plans to accelerate growth and reduce funding costs.
ndabbb34505.why: Sammaan Capital is an Indian non-banking financial company, and its earnings reflect lending growth and funding costs.

ne0e6a6a5b9.headline: Chicken shortage drives up depot prices
ne0e6a6a5b9.summary: Poultry depots in Trinidad and Tobago continue to face an ongoing chicken shortage. Depot owners said they had no choice but to raise prices.
ne0e6a6a5b9.why: Poultry is a staple protein, and supply shortages feed directly into consumer food inflation.

n1e43d8f63d.headline: Vance Says Cheap Oil and Gas Is Top U.S. Priority in Iran War
n1e43d8f63d.summary: Vice President JD Vance says keeping oil and gasoline prices low is now Washington's top priority in the Iran conflict. U.S. pump prices remain above $4 per gallon.
n1e43d8f63d.why: Energy prices feed into inflation and consumer spending, and U.S. policy choices on supply and sanctions shape global crude markets.

nd1c7c80976.headline: Tech giants unaware how many children on social media
nd1c7c80976.summary: Social media companies have been questioned about their failure to comply with Australia's social media ban for children. The companies were asked how many underage users they have.
nd1c7c80976.why: Large platforms face regulatory penalties and compliance costs when national rules restrict youth access to their services.

n21050e2295.headline: Persistent Etna ash shuts Sicily's busiest airport during peak holiday week
n21050e2295.summary: Ash from Mount Etna has forced the closure of Sicily's largest airport for the fifth consecutive day during the peak holiday week.
n21050e2295.why: Airport closures disrupt airline schedules, tourism revenue and cargo flows, and they can be costly for carriers and travel-dependent regional economies.

n369104ce5f.headline: New tax changes fuel Australia’s worsening rental crisis as investors flee - realestate.com.au
n369104ce5f.summary: REA Group research shows Australia's rental crisis is deepening, with soaring asking rents and fewer available properties across all capitals. The input links new tax changes to investors leaving the market.
n369104ce5f.why: Rental market conditions reflect housing supply and investor activity, which matter for property lending, household budgets and inflation in Australia.

nb451ba564f.headline: Goldman Sachs Says AI Unlikely To Cause Widespread Job Losses In India, Services Sector Faces Risk
nb451ba564f.summary: Goldman Sachs said India is unlikely to see widespread AI-driven job losses given the workforce's concentration in physical and mechanical roles. Services jobs, particularly in IT and call centres, face greater substitution risk.
nb451ba564f.why: Goldman Sachs is a major global investment bank whose economic research shapes investor views on labour markets and productivity.

nf8d613d750.headline: Economists upbeat on Malaysia's 2026 outlook after 6% 2Q GDP growth
nf8d613d750.summary: Economists have raised growth expectations for Malaysia's economy in 2026 after second-quarter GDP grew 6%, stronger than expected. The upgrade follows the better-than-forecast data.
nf8d613d750.why: Malaysia is a major Southeast Asian manufacturing and commodity exporter, and its GDP trends shape regional investment and currency views.

ndffc783efc.headline: Bank Of Baroda Raises ₹6,678 Crore Through Overseas Bonds, Investor Demand Peaks At ₹25,472 Crore
ndffc783efc.summary: Bank of Baroda raised about Rs 6,678 crore through overseas bonds after investor orders reached Rs 25,472 crore, nearly 3.8 times the issue size.
ndffc783efc.why: Bank of Baroda is one of India's large state-run lenders, and overseas bond issuance helps it fund lending and meet capital needs.

n66649b0fa3.headline: Indian tribunal allows Zee Entertainment to proceed with warrants issue; shares rise
n66649b0fa3.summary: An Indian appeals tribunal granted Zee Entertainment partial relief from a securities market ban, allowing it to proceed with a fundraise through a warrant issue. Shares rose after the ruling.
n66649b0fa3.why: Zee Entertainment is an Indian television broadcaster listed on NSE and BSE. Regulatory bans and fundraises directly affect its capital structure and share price.

na150e503b1.headline: Stock markets end lower amid geopolitical uncertainty; Nifty down for 4th day - OrissaPOST
na150e503b1.summary: Sensex and Nifty closed lower on Friday as elevated oil prices and the prolonged US-Iran impasse weighed on sentiment. The Sensex settled down 0.09% at 78,009.25.
na150e503b1.why: The Sensex and Nifty are benchmark indices of India's largest listed companies and track domestic and global risk sentiment.

n85758c69a1.headline: DRTech·TissueGene·Finemedix, All Rally [K-bio Pulse]
n85758c69a1.summary: Three Korean pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare names, DRTech, KolonTissueGene and FinediX, all posted gains on the 13th. The report gives no further detail on drivers.
n85758c69a1.why: Korea's biotech sector includes listed drug developers and medical device makers whose shares are sensitive to clinical, regulatory and funding news.

ne339a8235b.headline: India Wholesale Price Inflation Eases To 9.78%
ne339a8235b.summary: India's wholesale price inflation moderated slightly in July to its lowest level in three months. Slower growth in fuel and power prices drove the easing.
ne339a8235b.why: Wholesale inflation is a leading gauge of consumer price pressure and informs the Reserve Bank of India's rate decisions.

n379c7cfd65.headline: Trump Drone Tariffs Send Stocks Soaring
n379c7cfd65.summary: American drone companies rose in the stock market on Friday after President Trump announced plans to impose tariffs on imported drones, according to Axios.
n379c7cfd65.why: Tariffs on imported goods can protect domestic producers from foreign competition while raising costs for importers and buyers.
n379c7cfd65.why_moved: Planned tariffs on imported drones lifted American drone companies' shares on Friday, according to the report.

n07b23d72b9.headline: RBI closes special NRI deposit window by Aug 31 as inflows touch $52 bn
n07b23d72b9.summary: The Reserve Bank of India will close its special NRI deposit window by August 31, as inflows through FCNR(B) deposits touched $52.3 billion. The inflows came under the USD-INR forex swap facility.
n07b23d72b9.why: The RBI manages India's currency and foreign exchange reserves, and FCNR(B) inflows affect rupee liquidity and reserves.

nf94ea477c7.headline: Hormuz crisis: What UAE residents need to know this evening (August 14)
nf94ea477c7.summary: Maritime tensions, drone strikes and airline changes are disrupting travel routes in the Gulf, according to Gulf News' August 14 update for UAE residents.
nf94ea477c7.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key oil shipping chokepoint, so disruptions there affect energy flows, shipping costs and airline operations across the Gulf.

nbbf9951007.headline: BoB raises $700 mn  via overseas bonds
nbbf9951007.summary: State-owned Bank of Baroda raised $700 million through a dual-tranche overseas bond issuance with three-year and five-year maturities.
nbbf9951007.why: Bank of Baroda is one of India's largest public sector lenders, and overseas bond issuance is a common way for Indian banks to raise foreign-currency funding.

nd3b13d9476.headline: GIC Re’s profit jumps 10%
nd3b13d9476.summary: General Insurance Corporation of India reported a 10% year-on-year rise in profit after tax to Rs 19.2 billion ($201 million) for the quarter ended June 30.
nd3b13d9476.why: GIC Re is India's state-owned national reinsurer, providing reinsurance cover to domestic insurers and shaping the country's insurance market.

n22df5c3875.headline: RH Petrogas profit rises to $12.5m on higher oil prices, lower costs
n22df5c3875.summary: RH Petrogas posted a net profit of $12.54 million for the first half, as higher realised oil prices and lower production costs supported earnings.
n22df5c3875.why: RH Petrogas is a Singapore-listed oil and gas company, so its earnings depend on crude prices and production costs.

n967b7f4d46.headline: ET Exclusive: Pirojsha Godrej set to take charge at Godrej Industries with an ambitious growth plan
n967b7f4d46.summary: Pirojsha Godrej is set to lead Godrej Industries Group, succeeding Nadir Godrej, with a mandate to more than double the group's valuation in five years through sharper capital allocation.
n967b7f4d46.why: Godrej Industries is a major Indian conglomerate, and leadership changes there signal shifts in capital allocation across its businesses.

n15bb9f1eb0.headline: India’s cheap-urea model faces an expensive reckoning
n15bb9f1eb0.summary: India faces rising fertilizer costs, prompting a review of its subsidy system, as global supply chain issues and war have doubled procurement expenses.
n15bb9f1eb0.why: Urea is a key nitrogen fertilizer, and India's subsidy policy affects farm input costs, government spending and food inflation.

n0df828777c.headline: Svatantra Microfin flags 1,160 pc jump in operating cash outflow, high unsecured loan exposure, other risks in IPO papers
n0df828777c.summary: Svatantra Microfin has filed draft papers with SEBI to raise up to Rs 3,000 crore in an IPO. The filing flags a 1,160 percent jump in operating cash outflow and high unsecured loan exposure.
n0df828777c.why: Microfinance lenders extend small unsecured loans, and their IPO filings give investors detail on credit quality and funding risks.

n252f4616e4.headline: India WPI Inflation Eases Marginally To 9.78% In July As Food Inflation Rises
n252f4616e4.summary: India's wholesale price inflation eased marginally to 9.78% in July from 9.87% in June, led by lower fuel and power inflation. The WPI food index rose to 6.65%.
n252f4616e4.why: Wholesale price inflation is a leading indicator of consumer inflation and shapes the Reserve Bank of India's interest rate decisions.

n2d13ed0b38.headline: Pag-IBIG Fund, Avida and Amaia join hands to expand homeownership for Filipino workers
n2d13ed0b38.summary: Pag-IBIG Fund, Avida Land and Amaia Land signed a memorandum to expand housing choices for Filipino workers. Qualified members may finance special-rate homes with Pag-IBIG loans of up to PHP10 million.
n2d13ed0b38.why: Pag-IBIG Fund is the Philippines' state savings and housing financing agency, and its loans shape demand for local residential developers.

na754534c0f.headline: Software technology parks record over Rs 7.73 lakh crore worth exports in FY26
na754534c0f.summary: Exports from the Software Technology Park scheme surpassed Rs 7.73 lakh crore in financial year 2025-26, according to information tabled in Parliament by the IT Ministry.
na754534c0f.why: Software technology parks host IT exporters, which are a major source of foreign exchange earnings for India's services sector.

n39deaa6380.headline: TIDLOR Delivers Strong H1/26 Net Profit Up 26.2%, Driven by Lending & Insurance Brokerage
n39deaa6380.summary: Tidlor Holdings reported a second-quarter net profit of 1,533.2 million baht, up 18.3% year on year. Its total first-half net profit rose 26.2%, driven by lending and insurance brokerage.
n39deaa6380.why: Tidlor Holdings is a Thai consumer finance group, so its results indicate credit demand in Thailand's retail lending market.

n1278e626c9.headline: 4 criminal cases, several tax disputes pending against Shiprocket and its subsidiaries, shows DRHP
n1278e626c9.summary: Shiprocket's draft offer document discloses multiple pending criminal and tax proceedings involving the company and its subsidiaries. The IPO-bound firm is based in India.
n1278e626c9.why: Shiprocket is an Indian e-commerce logistics provider. Pending legal and tax matters disclosed before a listing are a key risk factor for IPO investors.

n005b09b68a.headline: Milan Stock Exchange Uncertain with Europe: Leonardo and Fincantieri Stand Out
n005b09b68a.summary: Piazza Affari opened without clear direction in line with Europe, with Leonardo and Fincantieri higher and Enel and STMicroelectronics lower. Oil was at $82 and gas at 60.6 euros per MWh.
n005b09b68a.why: Piazza Affari is the Milan stock exchange, and Leonardo and Fincantieri are Italian defence and shipbuilding groups, while Enel and STMicroelectronics are large utility and chip companies.
